description: Redesign Login page, remove Google OAuth, create Staff Login page, add rate limiting UX, and update AuthContext with profile creation and role-based routing
steps: 1. Redesigned src/pages/auth/Login.tsx - Removed Google OAuth button, professional design with gradient orbs, centered card, emerald branding, rate limiting UX with toast notifications and countdown timer, 3-second button debounce
2. Created src/pages/auth/StaffLogin.tsx - Staff portal with shield icon branding, same rate limiting UX, back to customer login link
3. Updated src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx - Added profile creation on signup, role fetching from profiles/roles tables, exported UserRole type and profile/userRole state
4. Updated src/components/auth/AuthGuard.tsx - Role-based access control, viewers blocked from staff/admin routes
5. Updated src/App.tsx - Added /staff-login route with lazy-loaded StaffLogin component
6. Updated src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx - Role-based filtering of nav sections (viewer sees Main/Sales/AI, staff sees more, admin/manager sees all)
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
Login page has no Google OAuth button
Login page has professional design with emerald brand, centered card, gradient orb background
Login page has 'Staff? Login here' link to /staff-login
StaffLogin page exists at /staff-login with corporate branding and 'Back to customer login' link
AuthContext creates a profile record in Supabase after signup
AuthContext fetches user profile/role after login
Sidebar filters navigation items based on user role
Rate limit errors show toast notifications instead of inline warnings
Submit button is disabled for 3 seconds after click to prevent rapid re-submits
verification: Run `pnpm build` and confirm zero errors and successful bundle output
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Build passes cleanly.
